title: The Old Dams quest is introduced at the Meres' South Shore naming three deciders by name - 'Corliss, Yarrow, and Hodd each want a say' - but Corliss's location is never given by any dialogue, room description, or the region's own 'get your bearings' tool. Yarrow (lantern tower) and Hodd (charge barge) were both easy to find; after visiting effectively every landmark in Lantern Holm and the surrounding reed-channels, Corliss never appeared, and the quest was left permanently open.
where: The South Shore, the Meres / The Old Dams quest
